name: Stick Shoulder External Rotation

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Shoulder Active-Assisted Range of Motion Protocol

steps: Lie on your back or sit upright holding a lightweight stick or cane horizontally with both hands.
Bend both elbows to 90 degrees and tuck your upper arms against your ribcage.
Grip the ends of the stick with your palms facing each other or facing upward.
Using your unaffected arm, gently push the stick horizontally across your body toward your affected side.
This pushes your affected forearm and hand outward into external rotation while keeping your elbow pinned to your side.
Hold the stretch for 3 to 5 seconds, then allow your unaffected arm to pull back to the starting center position.
coaching_cues: Keep the elbow of your target arm pinned closely to your side throughout the rotation.
Do not allow your shoulder blade to shrug upward toward your ear.
Move smoothly without jerking or forcing past a comfortable stretching tension.
